AppLocale FAQ

What does AppLocale include?

English and Simplified Chinese App Store fields you can paste into App Store Connect: title, subtitle, description, keyword notes, and screenshot overlay copy suggestions.

How fast is delivery?

Within 24 hours after your Stripe receipt. You receive files you can paste into App Store Connect.

Do you guarantee App Store rankings or downloads?

No. AppLocale improves clarity from your existing copy. We do not promise keyword position, search rank, or download growth.

Who is AppLocale for?

Indie iOS teams with a Simplified Chinese listing who are shipping or expanding to the US / English storefront — small teams without a full-time ASO hire.

How much does AppLocale cost?

$79 one-time via Stripe. Seller is Fortune Insight, LLC.

Issue 8 · 2026-08-28

Apple Search Ads ad variations route paid taps to approved Custom Product Pages — ad-group product-page choice, ad→landing creative congruence, geo and language constraints. Paid routing layer after Issue 5 CPP, Issue 6 In-App Events, and Issue 7 PPO. Not a fee change.

Issue 7 · 2026-08-27

Product Page Optimization (PPO) is Connect's organic experiment layer: treatment vs control on icons, screenshots, or app previews against the default page — traffic split, conversion metric, 90-day cap. Separate from Issue 5 CPP and Issue 6 In-App Events. Not a fee change.

Read Issue 7

Issue 6 · 2026-08-27

In-App Events add a time-boxed event card and details page on your product page, in search, and on Today/Games/Apps — the campaign layer after Issue 5 CPP. Per-locale event metadata; App Review reviews each event. Ship one event matching your first CPP keyword intent. Not a fee change.

Read Issue 6

Issue 5 · 2026-08-27

Custom Product Pages (up to 35 per app) let indie teams ship keyword-specific screenshot sets and unique URLs for Apple Search Ads — separate from Product Page Optimization. Use Connect keyword analytics from Issue 4 to pick which CPP to build first. Screenshot localization requires per-device, per-locale re-export. Not a fee change.

Issue 4 · 2026-08-25

Apple published Creative Assets best practices on 2026-08-05 ahead of a fall launch with iOS 27 — headers, search slots, and Asset Library submission. Storefront assets must meet a 4+ rating even when the app is higher. Connect keyword analytics live since 2026-07-01. Not a fee change.

Brazil CADE required Apple to respond by Monday 2026-08-24 to Epic's complaint; Epic claims alternative distribution in Brazil takes 9 steps (EU ~6 steps); Apple Brazil pages still list 5% CTC on off-store digital goods. Not a new US rate.

Apple announced updated App business terms in the EU, effective October 1, 2026. Standard commission on Apple IAP in the EU moves to 26%; Small Business Program and year-two subscriptions remain at 15%. US and non-EU paths are unchanged. Developers must accept new terms in App Store Connect.
